newsitem.title: USA: NYCE to use weighted averages on closing prices.
newsitem.headline: NYCE to use weighted averages on closing prices.

text.p: The New York Cotton Exchange (NYCE) said it will use a volume-weighted system to calculate the daily closing prices for cotton futures, effective August 25.
Currently, NYCE uses a mathematical average of all prices at which a contract trades during the close but does not account for the volume of trade during each recorded price.
The change is expected to allow daily settlement prices to more accurately reflect the value of transactions that takes place during the closing period, NYCE said.
